description: Saves one grid paste across many projects in a single transaction. Each project carries the PATCH bodies typing would send, applied in order. All or nothing: if any project fails, no project changes.

200.description: Every project in the request, in request order

program_name.description: Display name of the legacy Procore program the project belongs to (the flat-view Program column); null when unassigned.

portfolio_program_uuid.description: The portfolio-hierarchy node the project belongs to; null when unassigned. Always null on snapshot reads (not captured).

bid_type.description: A Procore default bid-type key, or the name of a company's own bid type.

created_by_name.description: Name of the user who created the project in Procore.

planned_amount.description: Effective Planned Amount. When the stored column is null and budget_cleared is false, this is resolved from COALESCE(revised_budget, estimated_budget) and tracks later budget changes. A stored "0.0...

budget_cleared.description: True when the Planned Amount was explicitly emptied (null + no budget tracking). False for untouched (tracks budget), set, or cleared-to-zero ("0.00") cells.

in_plan.description: Whether the project counts toward the capital plan. A project with no capital_plan_projects row reads as true.

422.description: INVALID_FORECAST: a month map is invalid, a project appears twice, or an edit fails as the single PATCH would (such as an end date before the start)

503.description: The permission check could not be completed (`AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE`) — safe to retry

edits.description: Applied in order, each as the single PATCH would apply it, so Change History records them the same way.
